Focus Vault uses this to detect when a blocked app is opened and show a block screen. It does not read any personal content on screen.
You\'re about to enter Strict Mode

Once this session starts, the selected apps and sites are locked for the full timer duration. There is no early exit, no emergency unlock, and no pause button. Only when the timer reaches zero will they unlock automatically.\n\nAre you sure you\'re ready to commit?

Lock Mode blocks the selected apps and sites for the full timer duration, but keeps an exit door: your PIN. Stopping early, using an emergency unlock, or changing Focus Vault\'s settings during the session will all ask for this PIN first.\n\nChoose a PIN you\'ll remember - you\'ll need it to get back in.
